name: Rumble Mix
source:
Harima works at a part-time job to give Tenma a Christmas present, but soon he finds himself in complex relations with both Tenma and Eri.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
播磨拳儿为了给塚本天满买圣诞礼物而外出打工，不料很快就发现，自己同时与天满和泽近爱理陷入了错综复杂的关系。
